# 74154 - 4-line-to-16-line decoder/demultiplexer

Package DIP-24 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74154.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74154.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 30 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74154 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74154.png) | ![74154 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74154.png) | ![74154 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74154.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 = NOT(G1' AND G2' AND D' AND C' AND B' AND A') | Low only when G1 and G2 are both low and D,C,B,A = 0. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Demultiplexer use: data on one strobe input with the other strobe low appears on the addressed output. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A, B, C or D | any output | PLH | 24 | 36 | 3 levels of logic; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| A, B, C or D | any output | PHL | 22 | 33 | 3 levels of logic; VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| G1 or G2 | any output | PLH | 20 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| G1 or G2 | any output | PHL | 18 | 27 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |

## Notes

Outputs active low; all outputs high when either strobe is high.
